content.value: Write a program that simulates a log-on to a remote system. The system can be accessed only if the user knows the password, which in case is “KUETMTE". If the user succeeds, simply print “Log-on Successful" and exit. If the user fails, then display “Access Denied" and exit.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
